name: omp-sub-burndown-indicator
description: One-line subscription quota burndown indicator for Oh My Pi

layout.description: Row layout: fit shrinks details to keep every subscription on one line; wrap keeps full details and moves whole segments to extra lines

windowView.description: Which quota window class(es) to show: 5h, week, month, or all present classes

exhaustedDisplay.description: Whether exhausted rows retain remaining quota or show reset only

exhaustedLabel.description: Use a full exhausted label or compact symbol

providerLabelMaxColumns.description: Maximum provider-label width in terminal columns; 0 disables clipping

opencodeGoConsoleCookie.description: opencode.ai console auth session cookie; enables exact OpenCode Go quota from the console page instead of the local estimate

opencodeGoWorkspace.description: OpenCode workspace id (wrk_…) for the console quota source; discovered automatically when empty
